fusions.name: Conjured Loper
fusions.desc: Sends a loping shape of arcane force that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. It stays beside you for 3 seconds, striking for 2 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Light-Bending Howl
fusions.desc: A howl that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles of you and ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Called From Candlelight
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to call a packmate of arcane light that fights beside you for 15 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Arc to the Nearest
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
